verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁਡੀਆ ਉਡਤ ਰਹੈ ਪਵਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਗੁਡੀ ਉਡ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pavan gavan jaise guddeeaa uddat rahai pavan rahit guddee udd na sakat hai ||

en.bdb: As a kite keeps aloft in the sky only if there is breeze blowing, and in the absence of breeze it drops down on the ground;

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੋਰੀ ਕੀ ਮਰੋਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਟੂਆ ਫਿਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਉ ਹਾਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਗਿਰ ਪਰੈ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਥਕਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ddoree kee maror jaise laTooaa firat rahai taau haau miTai gir parai haivai thakat hai ||

en.bdb: As a top keeps revolving on its axis/spindle as long as the torque provided to it by the thread lasts, where after it drops dead;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਅਸੁਧ ਜਿਉਂ ਕੁਠਾਰੀ ਠਹਰਾਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਕਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ka(n)chan asudh jiau(n) kuThaaree Thaharaat naahee sudh bhe nihachal chhab kai chhakat hai ||

en.bdb: As a base gold cannot remain stable in a crucible and on becoming pure, rests and acquire glitter;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹੈ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਮੋਨਿ ਨ ਬਕਤ ਹੈ ॥੯੫॥
verses.translit_en: dhuramat dhubidhaa bhramat hai chatur ku(n)T gurmat ek Tek mon na bakat hai ||95||

en.bdb: So does a person roams about in all the four directions due to duality and base intelligence. But once he takes the refuge of Guru's wisdom, he acquires peace and becomes engrossed within. (95)
